name: Microbiology and Molecular Genetics PhD
summary: Microbiology doctoral admission through the BioMolecular Science gateway, with research rotations before home program and laboratory selection.

english.note: Old-scale sections: reading/listening/speaking 19, writing 22. New-scale: reading/speaking 4, listening/writing 4.5. IELTS sections at least 6.0. Automatic waivers include qualifying completed U.S./English-speaking-country bachelor's and U.S.-campus AAU master's degrees; other waiver requests go through department.

applicationFee.note: GRIT feedback participants may receive waiver; participation deadline October 30 (year unstated). International eligibility not explicit; confirm. Graduate School offers McNair and targeted recruitment-event waivers; international eligibility not explicitly stated, confirm. FreeApp participation ends December 31, 2026.

documents: Unofficial transcripts for review; official transcripts/diplomas and certified translations upon acceptance
requirements.note: Select Microbiology & Molecular Genetics (Doctoral) within BMS; only one BMS application reviewed. GRE subject scores optional. No financial affidavit/bank statements required by BMS. Gateway guidelines favor four-year bachelor's, math/science preparation and research. Department handbook expects GPA 3.0, science/math 3.0, year each physics/inorganic/organic chemistry, biochemistry, integral calculus and biology.

funding.note: All BMS admits receive assistantship with living stipend, academic fees, tuition and health insurance. Amount explicitly projected for 2026–27. BMS page funds first two semesters then other sources; department handbook says 1.5 semesters and funding availability/progress conditions. Confirm the transition with program.
